4.2 Dataset

We evaluated our partitioning performance using several static undirected real and synthetic graph datasets from different graph data archives. Table 2 summarizes the basic characteristics of the datasets used in our experiments. We chose different sizes and a variety of graphs to observe the partitioning performance of the algorithm in the context of scalability. Different structure and volumes of data make differences in partitioning behavior and performance. For example, the degree of adjacent vertices of social networks data is positively correlated than another dataset[24].
